reviewNote: language draft; independent review and author acceptance are pending

strings.title: shape a text for its purpose
strings.lead: Choose a text type and profile. The source stays beside the preview; changes are visible before copying.
strings.protect: preserve spelling of names and terms
strings.endings: remove periods from short line endings
strings.spacing: trim excess spaces and blank lines
strings.protectMarkup: preserve markup, links, addresses, and module names
strings.empty: paste text on the left to see a preview
strings.boundary: Runs locally in this tab. Text is not sent or stored. Review names, quotations, markup, and meaning before use.
strings.note: profiles are starting rules - each can be changed
strings.caseNote: case conversion is mechanical; review names and language-specific rules

profiles.synaura: for authorial prose: lowercase, lighter endings, and clean spacing
profiles.syntaxium: for structured notes: keeps case and punctuation, tidies spacing
profiles.clear: for general prose: keeps case and endings, trims excess spaces
profiles.message: for messages and email: applies only the rules you choose
profiles.compact: for headings and labels: can remove a period from a short line
profiles.poetry: for verse: keeps line breaks and spacing; short-line punctuation is optional
profiles.faithful: for quotations and source text: all transformations are off
